headline: Sampling strategy governs which conformational states biomolecular methods recover
label: Biomolecular Conformational Ensemble Sampling
summary: Benchmarks of AlphaFold3, generative AI, and enhanced MD now test which conformational states each sampling approach actually recovers.
synthesis: The dominant thread is that the sampling procedure, more than the underlying model alone, determines which biomolecular conformations are recovered. In a T4 lysozyme benchmark, generative methods mostly missed buried features when sampling conformational states, as compared against AI-accelerated simulation and enhanced MD. Ensembles from AlphaFold3, AlphaFold2, and RosettaFold were scored against NMR, X-ray, cryo-EM, and MD flexibility profiles, with AF3 performing best. For intrinsically disordered proteins of 15 to 71 residues, OPES multithermal enhanced sampling in a single replica produces atomistic ensembles that reveal transient tertiary structure. What is new is explicit attention to the inference layer as a determinant of results across these studies. The evidence remains preprint-dominated, with only the OPES study published.
